description: This file contains functions related to managing and repairing 'allowFrom' policies in OpenClaw configuration, including wildcard checks, warnings, and modifications of nested account/channel configurations.

methods.name: hasWildcard
methods.description: Checks if a list contains a wildcard '*' element.

methods.name: collectOpenPolicyAllowFromWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings for missing wildcards in 'allowFrom' configurations and suggests a fix command.

methods.name: maybeRepairOpenPolicyAllowFrom
methods.description: Repairs 'allowFrom' settings in the configuration to ensure wildcards are present according to the specified mode.
